336:     private TradeSignal latestEligibleSignal(String symbol, String interval, TradeSignal newest, Instant evaluatedAt) {
337:         if (newest != null && newest.getGeneratedAt() != null && !newest.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(evaluatedAt)) {
338:             return newest;
339:         }
340:         return tradeSignalRepository
341:                 .findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndGeneratedAtLessThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, interval, evaluatedAt)
342:                 .orElse(null);
343:     }
344: 
345:     /**
346:      * FIX-117: TP extension must not erase Near-TP protection that was already earned.
347:      *
348:      * Only ARMED and REJECTION_DETECTED change from the pre-FIX-117 behavior. INACTIVE
349:      * still resets against the new geometry. FAILURE_CONFIRMED also keeps the existing
350:      * reset behavior because that persisted/transient lifecycle has a real interruption
351:      * window between state save and harvest resolution and is intentionally out of scope.
352:      * PARTIAL_HARVESTED remains terminal through the existing harvest-used guard.
353:      *
354:      * plannedDistance is recalculated from the current TP by NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy
355:      * on every evaluation, so the historical best price remains a valid market observation
356:      * and does not need synthetic rebasing after an extension.
357:      */
358:     private void resetNearTpTrackingForNewRiskGeometry(WalletManagedPosition managed) {
359:         if (managed.isNearTpHarvestUsed()) return;
360: 
361:         NearTpState currentState = managed.getNearTpState() == null
362:                 ? NearTpState.INACTIVE : managed.getNearTpState();
363:         switch (currentState) {
364:             case INACTIVE, NEAR_TP_FAILURE_CONFIRMED -> {
365:                 // Existing behavior: no earned protection is carried into the new geometry.
366:                 managed.setNearTpState(NearTpState.INACTIVE);
367:                 managed.setNearTpBestPrice(null);
368:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
369:                 managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(null);
370:             }
371:             case NEAR_TP_ARMED -> {
372:                 // FIX-117: preserve earned protection and the real historical best price.
373:             }
374:             case NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED -> {
375:                 // Preserve earned protection/best price, but discard bearish persistence
376:                 // accumulated under the old, tighter geometry. The next evaluation will
377:                 // recalculate giveback against the new TP and either recover or remain rejected.
378:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
379:                 managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(null);
380:             }
381:             case NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED -> {
382:                 // Existing terminal behavior; normally returned above by nearTpHarvestUsed.
383:             }
384:         }
385:     }
386: 
387:     private boolean sameDecimal(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) {
388:         return a == null ? b == null : b != null && a.compareTo(b) == 0;
389:     }
390: 
391:     private void closePaper(String symbol, BigDecimal exitPrice, PositionStatus status,
392:                             String closeReason, String explanation, TradeSignal sourceSignal) {
393:         PaperPosition paper = paperPositionRepository.findBySymbolAndStatus(symbol, PositionStatus.OPEN).orElse(null);
394:         if (paper == null) return;
395:         BigDecimal remainingPnl = exitPrice.subtract(paper.getEntryPrice(), MC).multiply(paper.getQuantity(), MC);
396:         // FIX-11T: paper_position may already contain realized P&L from a Near-TP partial
397:         // harvest. Preserve it when the remaining quantity is later closed.
398:         BigDecimal pnl = (paper.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : paper.getRealizedPnl())
399:                 .add(remainingPnl, MC);
400:         paper.setExitPrice(exitPrice);
401:         paper.setRealizedPnl(pnl);
402:         paper.setStatus(status);
403:         paper.setCloseReason(closeReason);
404:         paper.setExitReason(explanation);
405:         paper.setClosedAt(Instant.now());
406:         PaperPosition saved = paperPositionRepository.save(paper);
407: 
408:         // FIX-028: live-price exits (TP/SL/Profit Lock/normal exit) also write the
409:         // immutable audit record. sourceSignal is context only unless the closeTrigger
410:         // itself is a genuine SELL decision. No protection/exit policy is changed here.
411:         productionExitAuditService.record(saved, sourceSignal, closeReason, explanation);
412:     }

43:     public Optional<PaperPosition> process(long signalId, boolean background,
44:             Function<TradeSignal,Optional<PaperPosition>> business, Long sourceEventId) {
45:         if(TransactionSynchronizationManager.isActualTransactionActive())
46:             throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 caller must be outside the processing transaction");
47:         if(!background && !store.exists(signalId)) {
48:             // Automatic callers have already registered atomically with creation.
49:             // Explicit existing-signal calls register only at the user's request.
50:             transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->store.register(signals.findById(signalId)
51:                     .orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal not found: "+signalId)),ProcessingOrigin.EXPLICIT));
52:         }
53:         store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
54:         for(int localAttempt=0;localAttempt<2;localAttempt++) {
55:             var work=store.claim(signalId,background);
56:             if(work==null) {
57:                 log.info("[FIX-127][NOT_CLAIMED] signalId={}, background={}; no processing performed",signalId,background);
58:                 return Optional.empty();
59:             }
60:             log.info("[FIX-127][ATTEMPT] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, candleOpenTime={}, origin={}, attempt={}, background={}",
61:                     signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.candleOpenTime(),work.origin(),work.attempts(),background);
62:             java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger completion=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(-1);
63:             try {
64:                 Optional<PaperPosition> result=transaction.execute(tx->{
65:                     org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
66:                         new org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization() {
67:                             @Override public void afterCompletion(int status) { completion.set(status); }
68:                         });
69:                     // FIX-140: observe the real transaction completion; a thrown exception alone
70:                     // does not prove rollback. The private marker is only created here.
71:                     if(walletCoordination!=null) {
72:                         try { walletCoordination.symbol(work.symbol()); }
73:                         catch(RuntimeException failure) {
74:                             if(sourceEventId!=null && retryableSymbolLock(failure))throw new SymbolLockFailure(failure);
75:                             throw failure;
76:                         }
77:                     }
78:                     var owned=store.locked(signalId);
79:                     if(owned==null || !"RUNNING".equals(owned.status()) || !work.owner().equals(owned.owner()))
80:                         throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 processing ownership changed");
81:                     // Acquire before PositionManagementService inserts a referencing
82:                     // advisory or executes POSITION_STOP_LOSS. No rules evaluated yet.
83:                     try {
84:                         positions.findFirstBySymbolAndStatusOrderByOpenedAtDesc(work.symbol(),"OPEN");
85:                     } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
86:                         if(InitialPositionLockDeadlock.isMysqlDeadlock(ex))throw new InitialLockFailure(ex);
87:                         throw ex;
88:                     }
89:                     store.requireSourceOwner(signalId,sourceEventId);
90:                     // Read signal/freshness after lock acquisition: lock wait must not
91:                     // consume the recovery grace before it is checked, or establish an
92:                     // ordinary repeatable-read snapshot before the position is locked.
93:                     TradeSignal signal=signals.findById(signalId).orElseThrow(()->new IllegalArgumentException("Signal missing"));
94:                     if(!work.symbol().equals(signal.getSymbol()) || !work.interval().equals(signal.getInterval())
95:                             || !work.candleOpenTime().equals(signal.getCandleOpenTime()))
96:                         throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-127 signal lineage changed");
97:                     // FIX-153: every claimed attempt, including the first direct
98:                     // attempt regardless of origin, is checked after normal locks.
99:                     if(!freshness.eligible(work))throw new Expired();

101:                     store.complete(work,outcome.map(PaperPosition::getId).orElse(null));
102:                     return outcome;
103:                 });
104:                 log.info("[FIX-127][COMPLETED] signalId={}, symbol={}, interval={}, attempt={}; processing committed (not necessarily a trade)",
105:                         signalId,work.symbol(),work.interval(),work.attempts());
106:                 return result;
107:             } catch(Expired ex) {
108:                 // Only exact RUNNING ownership can expire this attempt, after business TX rolled back.
109:                 if(store.finishWithoutBusiness(work,"EXPIRED","FRESHNESS","Exact candle is no longer latest and fresh")!=1)
110:                     throw new IllegalStateException("FIX-153 expiry ownership unconfirmed: signal="+signalId);
111:                 log.warn("[FIX-127][EXPIRED] signalId={}, symbol={}, attempt={}",signalId,work.symbol(),work.attempts());
112:                 return Optional.empty();
113:             } catch(RuntimeException ex) {
114:                 // FIX-140: only this invocation's initial symbol-lock marker plus a
115:                 // confirmed rollback grants retry. Unknown connection/commit failures stay review-only.
116:                 if(ex instanceof SymbolLockFailure && completion.get()==

483:         productionExitAuditService.record(saved, signal, "PROFIT_LOCK", profitLock.explanation());
484:         return saved;

490:             PositionStatus status,

492:             String explanation,
493:             TradeSignal exitSignal
494:     ) {

498:         BigDecimal pnl = (position.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : position.getRealizedPnl())
499:                 .add(remainingPnl, MC);

502:         position.setRealizedPnl(pnl);
503:         position.setStatus(status);
504:         position.setCloseReason(closeReason);
505:         position.setExitReason(explanation);
506:         position.setExitSignal(exitSignal);
507:         position.setClosedAt(Instant.now());

512:         executionIntelligenceService.completePositionOpportunity(position.getSymbol(), exitSignal, closeReason);

514:         if (exitSignal != null) {

517:                 // reason in wallet history. A TAKE_PROFIT/STOP_LOSS may use the latest 1m
518:                 // signal as its price/context carrier even when that signal is WATCH. Calling
519:                 // executeSell(...) used to mislabel those exits as SIGNAL_SELL.

521:                     walletAutoExecutionService.executeSell(exitSignal);

527:             }
528:         }
529: 
530:         // FIX-028: immutable production audit records the actual close trigger separately
531:         // from the latest market signal. This is diagnostic only and cannot alter execution.
532:         productionExitAuditService.record(saved, exitSignal, closeReason, explanation);
533:         return saved;
534:     }

543:     private void enforceDailyLossLimit() {
544:         Instant startOfDay = LocalDate.now(ZoneOffset.UTC).atStartOfDay().toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
545:         BigDecimal pnl = positionRepository.sumRealizedPnlSince(startOfDay);
546:         BigDecimal maximumLoss = properties.paperAccountBalance()
547:                 .multiply(properties.maxDailyLossPercent(), MC)
548:                 .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), MC)
549:                 .negate();
550: 
551:         if (pnl.compareTo(maximumLoss) <= 0) {
552:             throw new IllegalStateException("Daily loss limit reached");
553:         }
554:     }

251:     private void evaluateNearTpProtection(WalletManagedPosition managed, BigDecimal price,
252:                                           TradeSignal oneMinute, TradeSignal fiveMinute) {
253:         // FIX-11T evidence is explicitly time-safe. Normal Production logic above keeps its
254:         // existing signal lookup unchanged; Near-TP alone falls back to an at-or-before query
255:         // if the repository's newest row is future-dated relative to this live evaluation.
256:         Instant evaluatedAt = Instant.now();
257:         oneMinute = latestEligibleSignal(managed.getSymbol(), "1m", oneMinute, evaluatedAt);
258:         fiveMinute = latestEligibleSignal(managed.getSymbol(), "5m", fiveMinute, evaluatedAt);
259: 
260:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State state = new NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State(
261:                 managed.getNearTpState() == null ? NearTpState.INACTIVE : managed.getNearTpState(),
262:                 managed.getNearTpBestPrice(), managed.getNearTpBearishStreak(),
263:                 managed.getNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), managed.isNearTpHarvestUsed());
264: 
265:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.Evaluation evaluation = nearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
266:                 state, managed.getAverageEntryPriceUsdt(), managed.getTakeProfitUsdt(),
267:                 price, evaluatedAt, oneMinute, fiveMinute);
268: 
269:         NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy.State next = evaluation.state();
270:         boolean stateChanged = managed.getNearTpState() != next.nearTpState()
271:                 || !sameDecimal(managed.getNearTpBestPrice(), next.bestPrice())
272:                 || managed.getNearTpBearishStreak() != next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute()
273:                 || !java.util.Objects.equals(managed.getNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(), next.lastEvaluatedOneMinuteSignalId());
274:         if (stateChanged) {
275:             managed.setNearTpState(next.nearTpState());
276:             managed.setNearTpBestPrice(next.bestPrice());
277:             managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute());
278:             managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(next.lastEvaluatedOneMinuteSignalId());
279:             managed.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
280:             managedPositionRepository.save(managed);
281:         }
282: 
283:         if (evaluation.transition() || stateChanged) {
284:             log.info("FIX-11T Near-TP evaluation: positionId={}, symbol={}, state={}, code={}, price={}, bestPrice={}, " +
285:                             "tpProgressPct={}, givebackPct={}, bearish1mStreak={}, oneMinuteId={}, oneMinuteOriginal={}, " +
286:                             "fiveMinuteId={}, fiveMinuteOriginal={}, detail={}",
287:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), next.nearTpState(), evaluation.code(), price, next.bestPrice(),
288:                     evaluation.tpProgressPercent(), evaluation.givebackPercent(), next.consecutiveBearishOneMinute(),
289:                     oneMinute == null ? null : oneMinute.getId(),
290:                     oneMinute == null ? null : oneMinute.getOriginalDecision(),
291:                     fiveMinute == null ? null : fiveMinute.getId(),
292:                     fiveMinute == null ? null : fiveMinute.getOriginalDecision(),
293:                     evaluation.explanation());
294:         } else if (log.isDebugEnabled() && evaluation.code().startsWith("HOLD_")) {
295:             log.debug("FIX-11T Near-TP hold: positionId={}, symbol={}, code={}, price={}, detail={}",
296:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), evaluation.code(), price, evaluation.explanation());
297:         }
298: 
299:         if (!evaluation.harvestEligible()) return;
300: 
301:         WalletAutoExecutionService.PartialHarvestResult harvest = walletAutoExecutionService
302:                 .executeNearTpPartialHarvest(managed.getSymbol(), price, evaluation.explanation());
303:         if (!harvest.executed()) {
304:             log.warn("FIX-11T Near-TP harvest not executed: positionId={}, symbol={}, status={}, price={}",
305:                     managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), harvest.status(), price);
306:             // If execution did not happen, return to rejection monitoring rather than leaving
307:             // the state stranded in FAILURE_CONFIRMED. Idempotency still lives in wallet_trade.
308:             managed.setNearTpState(NearTpState.NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED);
309:             if ("BELOW_BINANCE_MINIMUM".equals(harvest.status())
310:                     || "BINANCE_MINIMUM_UNAVAILABLE".equals(harvest.status())) {
311:                 // The skipped order consumed the current confirmation pair. Requiring fresh
312:                 // bearish evidence prevents a retry on every subsequent market-price tick.
313:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
314:             }
315:             managed.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
316:             managedPositionRepository.save(managed);
317:             return;
318:         }
319: 
320:         // Keep paper_position quantity/P&L synchronized with the managed wallet lifecycle.
321:         // Without this, a later terminal signal close would calculate P&L on pre-harvest quantity.
322:         PaperPosition paper = paperPositionRepository.findBySymbolAndStatus(managed.getSymbol(), PositionStatus.OPEN).orElse(null);
323:         if (paper != null) {
324:             paper.setQuantity(harvest.remainingQuantity());
325:             BigDecimal priorRealized = paper.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : paper.getRealizedPnl();
326:             paper.setRealizedPnl(priorRealized.add(harvest.realizedPnlUsdt(), MC));
327:             paperPositionRepository.save(paper);
328:         }
329: 
330:         log.info("FIX-11T NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED: positionId={}, symbol={}, soldQty={}, remainingQty={}, " +
331:                         "price={}, realizedPnl={}, realizedPnlPct={}",
332:                 managed.getId(), managed.getSymbol(), harvest.soldQuantity(), harvest.remainingQuantity(),
333:                 price, harvest.realizedPnlUsdt(), harvest.realizedPnlPercent());
334:     }

336:     private TradeSignal latestEligibleSignal(String symbol, String interval, TradeSignal newest, Instant evaluatedAt) {
337:         if (newest != null && newest.getGeneratedAt() != null && !newest.getGeneratedAt().isAfter(evaluatedAt)) {
338:             return newest;
339:         }
340:         return tradeSignalRepository
341:                 .findTopBySymbolAndIntervalAndGeneratedAtLessThanEqualOrderByGeneratedAtDesc(symbol, interval, evaluatedAt)
342:                 .orElse(null);
343:     }

345:     /**
346:      * FIX-117: TP extension must not erase Near-TP protection that was already earned.
347:      *
348:      * Only ARMED and REJECTION_DETECTED change from the pre-FIX-117 behavior. INACTIVE
349:      * still resets against the new geometry. FAILURE_CONFIRMED also keeps the existing
350:      * reset behavior because that persisted/transient lifecycle has a real interruption
351:      * window between state save and harvest resolution and is intentionally out of scope.
352:      * PARTIAL_HARVESTED remains terminal through the existing harvest-used guard.
353:      *
354:      * plannedDistance is recalculated from the current TP by NearTpFailureProtectionPolicy
355:      * on every evaluation, so the historical best price remains a valid market observation
356:      * and does not need synthetic rebasing after an extension.
357:      */
358:     private void resetNearTpTrackingForNewRiskGeometry(WalletManagedPosition managed) {
359:         if (managed.isNearTpHarvestUsed()) return;
360: 
361:         NearTpState currentState = managed.getNearTpState() == null
362:                 ? NearTpState.INACTIVE : managed.getNearTpState();
363:         switch (currentState) {
364:             case INACTIVE, NEAR_TP_FAILURE_CONFIRMED -> {
365:                 // Existing behavior: no earned protection is carried into the new geometry.
366:                 managed.setNearTpState(NearTpState.INACTIVE);
367:                 managed.setNearTpBestPrice(null);
368:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
369:                 managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(null);
370:             }
371:             case NEAR_TP_ARMED -> {
372:                 // FIX-117: preserve earned protection and the real historical best price.
373:             }
374:             case NEAR_TP_REJECTION_DETECTED -> {
375:                 // Preserve earned protection/best price, but discard bearish persistence
376:                 // accumulated under the old, tighter geometry. The next evaluation will
377:                 // recalculate giveback against the new TP and either recover or remain rejected.
378:                 managed.setNearTpBearishStreak(0);
379:                 managed.setNearTpLastOneMinuteSignalId(null);
380:             }
381:             case NEAR_TP_PARTIAL_HARVESTED -> {
382:                 // Existing terminal behavior; normally returned above by nearTpHarvestUsed.
383:             }
384:         }
385:     }

387:     private boolean sameDecimal(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) {
388:         return a == null ? b == null : b != null && a.compareTo(b) == 0;
389:     }

391:     private void closePaper(String symbol, BigDecimal exitPrice, PositionStatus status,
392:                             String closeReason, String explanation, TradeSignal sourceSignal) {
393:         PaperPosition paper = paperPositionRepository.findBySymbolAndStatus(symbol, PositionStatus.OPEN).orElse(null);
394:         if (paper == null) return;
395:         BigDecimal remainingPnl = exitPrice.subtract(paper.getEntryPrice(), MC).multiply(paper.getQuantity(), MC);
396:         // FIX-11T: paper_position may already contain realized P&L from a Near-TP partial
397:         // harvest. Preserve it when the remaining quantity is later closed.
398:         BigDecimal pnl = (paper.getRealizedPnl() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : paper.getRealizedPnl())
399:                 .add(remainingPnl, MC);
400:         paper.setExitPrice(exitPrice);
401:         paper.setRealizedPnl(pnl);
402:         paper.setStatus(status);
403:         paper.setCloseReason(closeReason);
404:         paper.setExitReason(explanation);
405:         paper.setClosedAt(Instant.now());
406:         PaperPosition saved = paperPositionRepository.save(paper);
407: 
408:         // FIX-028: live-price exits (TP/SL/Profit Lock/normal exit) also write the
409:         // immutable audit record. sourceSignal is context only unless the closeTrigger
410:         // itself is a genuine SELL decision. No protection/exit policy is changed here.
411:         productionExitAuditService.record(saved, sourceSignal, closeReason, explanation);

1: package com.crypto.position.service;
2: 
3: import com.crypto.domain.SignalDecision;
4: import com.crypto.domain.TradeSignal;
5: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
6: 
7: /**
8:  * Shared production/replay exit authority for an already-open long position.
9:  *
10:  * The policy deliberately separates short-timeframe noise from a genuine
11:  * higher-timeframe breakdown:
12:  *  - a 1m pullback alone never closes the position;
13:  *  - the existing 1m SELL + bearish 5m confirmation remains valid;
14:  *  - a fresh 1h SELL may close a position when 5m is no longer supportive;
15:  *  - a Profit Lock breach is tolerated while 5m/1h still support the bullish thesis.
16:  */
17: @Component
18: public class PositionExitPolicy {
19: 
20:     public Evaluation evaluateNormalExit(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour) {
21:         SignalDecision currentDecision = decision(current);
22:         SignalDecision fiveDecision = decision(fiveMinute);
23:         SignalDecision oneDecision = decision(oneHour);
24: 
25:         boolean oneHourBreakdown = bearish(oneDecision)
26:                 && fiveMinute != null
27:                 && !supportive(fiveDecision);
28:         if (oneHourBreakdown) {
29:             return Evaluation.exit("HTF_SELL_CONFIRMED",
30:                     "1h turned " + label(oneDecision)
31:                             + " while 5m is no longer supportive (" + label(fiveDecision)
32:                             + "). The higher-timeframe bullish thesis is broken; close the managed position.");
33:         }
34: 
35:         boolean lowerFrameConfirmed = current != null
36:                 && "1m".equals(current.getInterval())
37:                 && bearish(currentDecision)
38:                 && fiveMinute != null
39:                 && bearish(fiveDecision)
40:                 && (oneHour == null || !bullish(oneDecision));
41:         if (lowerFrameConfirmed) {
42:             return Evaluation.exit("SELL_CONFIRMED",
43:                     "1m " + label(currentDecision) + " is confirmed by bearish 5m while 1h is not bullish.");
44:         }
45: 
46:         return Evaluation.hold("No confirmed multi-timeframe exit."
47:                 + " current=" + label(currentDecision)
48:                 + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
49:                 + ", 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ".");
50:     }
51: 
52:     public Evaluation evaluateProfitLockBreach(TradeSignal current, TradeSignal fiveMinute, TradeSignal oneHour) {
53:         SignalDecision currentDecision = decision(current);
54:         SignalDecision fiveDecision = decision(fiveMinute);
55:         SignalDecision oneDecision = decision(oneHour);
56: 
57:         // Strong HTF support: tolerate a sharp 1m pullback instead of throwing away the trend.
58:         if (bullish(oneDecision) && fiveMinute != null && supportive(fiveDecision)) {
59:             return Evaluation.hold("PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD",
60:                     "Profit Lock was breached, but higher-timeframe continuation remains healthy:"
61:                             + " 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
62:                             + ", current=" + label(currentDecision)
63:                             + ". Treat the breach as a protected pullback, not an immediate SELL.");
64:         }
65: 
66:         // Cooling but still-supported trend: WATCH/WATCH is allowed to breathe while the current frame is not bearish.
67:         if (oneDecision == SignalDecision.WATCH
68:                 && fiveMinute != null && supportive(fiveDecision)
69:                 && !bearish(currentDecision)) {
70:             return Evaluation.hold("PROFIT_LOCK_HOLD",
71:                     "Profit Lock was breached during a supported consolidation:"
72:                             + " 1h=WATCH, 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
73:                             + ", current=" + label(currentDecision)
74:                             + ". Keep the winner protected while waiting for higher-timeframe confirmation.");
75:         }
76: 
77:         if (bearish(oneDecision)) {
78:             return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_HTF_EXIT",
79:                     "Profit Lock was breached and 1h is " + label(oneDecision)
80:                             + "; higher-timeframe support has failed.");
81:         }
82: 
83:         if (bearish(currentDecision) && bearish(fiveDecision)) {
84:             return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_BEARISH_CONFIRMATION",
85:                     "Profit Lock was breached with bearish 1m and 5m confirmation.");
86:         }
87: 
88:         return Evaluation.exit("PROFIT_LOCK_EXIT",
89:                 "Profit Lock was breached without enough higher-timeframe bullish support to justify a protected hold:"
90:                         + " current=" + label(currentDecision)
91:                         + ", 5m=" + label(fiveDecision)
92:                         + ", 1h=" + label(oneDecision) + ".");
93:     }
94: 
95:     private SignalDecision decision(TradeSignal signal) {
96:         return signal == null ? null : signal.getDecision();
97:     }
98: 
99:     private boolean supportive(SignalDecision decision) {
100:         return decision == SignalDecision.BUY
101:                 || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY
102:                 || decision == SignalDecision.WATCH;
103:     }
104: 
105:     private boolean bullish(SignalDecision decision) {
106:         return decision == SignalDecision.BUY || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_BUY;
107:     }
108: 
109:     private boolean bearish(SignalDecision decision) {
110:         return decision == SignalDecision.SELL || decision == SignalDecision.STRONG_SELL;
111:     }
112: 
113:     private String label(SignalDecision decision) {
114:         return decision == null ? "MISSING" : decision.name();
115:     }
116: 
117:     public record Evaluation(boolean exit, String code, String explanation) {
118:         public static Evaluation exit(String code, String explanation) {
119:             return new Evaluation(true, code, explanation);
120:         }
121: 
122:         public static Evaluation hold(String explanation) {
123:             return new Evaluation(false, "HOLD", explanation);
124:         }
125: 
126:         public static Evaluation hold(String code, String explanation) {
127:             return new Evaluation(false, code, explanation);
128:         }
129:     }

12: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
13: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
14: 
15: import java.time.Instant;
16: 
17: /**
18:  * FIX-028: records the actual production exit cause without changing execution.
19:  *
20:  * Example that motivated the audit: BTC hit TAKE_PROFIT while the latest 1m signal
21:  * was WATCH. The legacy wallet ledger called that SIGNAL_SELL because it reused the
22:  * current signal as an execution carrier. This service preserves both facts:
23:  * closeTrigger=TAKE_PROFIT and sourceSignalDecision=WATCH.
24:  */
25: @Service
26: @RequiredArgsConstructor
27: public class ProductionExitAuditService {
28:     private final ProductionExitAuditRepository auditRepository;
29:     private final WalletManagedPositionRepository managedPositionRepository;
30:     private final PositionAnalysisRepository positionAnalysisRepository;
31: 
32:     @Transactional
33:     public void record(PaperPosition paper, TradeSignal sourceSignal, String closeTrigger, String explanation) {
34:         if (paper == null || paper.getId() == null || paper.getExitPrice() == null || closeTrigger == null) return;
35:         if (auditRepository.findTopByPaperPositionIdOrderByAuditedAtDesc(paper.getId()).isPresent()) return;
36: 
37:         WalletManagedPosition managed = paper.getSignal() == null ? null : managedPositionRepository
38:                 .findTopByEntrySignalIdOrderByOpenedAtDesc(paper.getSignal().getId()).orElse(null);
39:         PositionAnalysis analysis = managed == null || managed.getId() == null ? null : positionAnalysisRepository
40:                 .findTopByWalletPositionIdOrderByAnalyzedAtDesc(managed.getId()).orElse(null);
41: 
42:         auditRepository.save(ProductionExitAudit.builder()
43:                 .paperPositionId(paper.getId())
44:                 .walletPositionId(managed == null ? null : managed.getId())
45:                 .symbol(paper.getSymbol())
46:                 .closeTrigger(closeTrigger)
47:                 .sourceSignalId(sourceSignal == null ? null : sourceSignal.getId())
48:                 .sourceSignalDecision(sourceSignal == null || sourceSignal.getDecision() == null ? null : sourceSignal.getDecision().name())
49:                 .sourceSignalOriginalDecision(sourceSignal == null || sourceSignal.getOriginalDecision() == null ? null : sourceSignal.getOriginalDecision().name())
50:                 .positionAnalysisId(analysis == null ? null : analysis.getId())
51:                 .positionRecommendation(analysis == null || analysis.getRecommendation() == null ? null : analysis.getRecommendation().name())
52:                 .entryPriceUsdt(paper.getEntryPrice())
53:                 .exitPriceUsdt(paper.getExitPrice())
54:                 .stopLossUsdt(paper.getStopLoss())
55:                 .takeProfitUsdt(paper.getTakeProfit())
56:                 .closeExplanation(explanation)
57:                 .auditedAt(Instant.now())
58:                 .build());
59:     }
60: }

13: /** FIX-124: commit market input before locking a position. Execute protection
14:  * before publishing the closed-candle event, preserving that ordering. No outer
15:  * transaction may retain candle locks while a protection transaction runs.
16:  */
17: @Service
18: public class KlineTransactionCoordinator {
19:     private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KlineTransactionCoordinator.class);
20:     private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2;
21:     private KlineTiming timing = KlineTiming.loggingOnly();
22:     @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
23:     public void setTiming(KlineTiming timing) { this.timing = timing; }
24:     private final TransactionTemplate transaction;
25:     private final Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics;
26: 
27:     public KlineTransactionCoordinator(PlatformTransactionManager manager, Fix124ProtectionStore diagnostics) {
28:         transaction = new TransactionTemplate(manager);
29:         transaction.setPropagationBehavior(TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW);
30:         // FIX-153: current committed ordering after consistency locks; bound JDBC transaction work.
31:         transaction.setIsolationLevel(TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_READ_COMMITTED);
32:         transaction.setTimeout(30);
33:         this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
34:     }
35: 
36:     public void process(String symbol, String interval, Instant candleOpenTime, Instant observedAt,
37:                         BigDecimal price, Runnable persistInput, Runnable protect,
38:                         Runnable observe, Runnable publishClosed) {
39:         var context = timing.context(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, null);
40:         // Candle and exact canonical price observation commit together. A failed
41:         // input write must not produce an unrecorded protection decision.
42:         try {
43:             timing.measure(context,"INPUT_TRANSACTION",false,()->transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx->persistInput.run()));
44:             com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_COMMITTED);
45:         }catch(RuntimeException failure){
46:             com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.INPUT_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);throw failure;
47:         }
48:         // FIX-131: executeWithoutResult returned successfully: this is input COMMIT, not callback completion.
49:         try { com.crypto.client.binance.websocket.KlineReceipt.inputCommitted(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt); }
50:         catch (RuntimeException diagnosticFailure) { log.warn("[FIX-131][RECEIPT_DIAGNOSTIC_FAILED] symbol={}", symbol, diagnosticFailure); }
51:         if (protect != null) {
52:             int attempts = 0;
53:             RuntimeException failure = null;
54:             do {
55:                 attempts++;
56:                 try {
57:                     timing.measure(context, "PROTECTION_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> protect.run()));
58:                     failure = null;
59:                     break;
60:                 } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
61:                     failure = ex;
62:                     // FIX-153: completion returned/failed; a commit exception alone does not prove rollback.
63:                     // Never retry a late wallet/commit error or an unknown outcome.
64:                     if (!(ex instanceof InitialPositionLockDeadlock) || attempts == MAX_ATTEMPTS) break;
65:                     log.warn("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][INITIAL_LOCK_RETRY] symbol={}, candleOpenTime={}, observedAt={}, attempt={}",
66:                             symbol, candleOpenTime, observedAt, attempts);
67:                 }
68:             } while (attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS);
69:             if (failure != null || attempts > 1) {
70:                 String outcome = failure == null ? "RECOVERED" : "FAILED";
71:                 if (failure == null) {
72:                     log.info("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][RECOVERED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}", symbol, observedAt, attempts);
73:                 } else {
74:                     com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.count(com.crypto.local.LocalRuntimeDiagnostics.Event.PROTECTION_FAILED_OR_UNCONFIRMED);
75:                     log.error("[FIX-124][PRODUCTION][FAILED] symbol={}, observedAt={}, attempts={}; input committed; protection completion failed or unconfirmed, consult durable price evidence",
76:                             symbol, observedAt, attempts, failure);
77:                 }
78:                 diagnostics.record(symbol, interval, candleOpenTime, observedAt, price, attempts, outcome, failure);
79:             }
80:         }
81:         if (observe != null) {
82:             try {
83:                 timing.measure(context, "OBSERVER_TRANSACTION", false, () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> observe.run()));
84:             } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
85:                 log.warn("[FIX-124][OBSERVER_FAILED] symbol={}; input committed; protection outcome remains in durable price evidence", symbol, ex);
86:             }
87:         }
88:         // AFTER_COMMIT listener still receives an actual committed transaction;
89:         // publishing outside a transaction would silently drop the analysis event.
90:         if (publishClosed != null) timing.measure(context, "CLOSE_DISPATCH_TRANSACTION", false,
91:                 () -> transaction.executeWithoutResult(tx -> publishClosed.run()));
92:     }
93: }

## FINDINGS — Iteration 4: Code / Trade Route

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** The frozen scope remains only `paper_position` IDs `182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137`. No trade-specific DB result exists yet in the permitted Codex evidence folder, so none of the current source routes can be attributed to an individual frozen trade.

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** A direct 1m Binance kline follows this current route: candle plus `market_price_event(PENDING)` input transaction → separate protection transaction → observer → closed-candle dispatch. The protection transaction is deliberately before analysis dispatch. [BinanceKlineService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/BinanceKlineService.java:101), [KlineTransactionCoordinator.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/infrastructure/transaction/KlineTransactionCoordinator.java:40)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** For an accepted direct-price observation, protection locks the open managed position, rejects stale/future/out-of-order observations, evaluates TP, absolute SL, profit-lock, then normal multi-timeframe exit logic. A successful callback writes `market_price_event.delivery_status=APPLIED` in the same effects transaction; the `PRICE_OUTCOME_COMMITTED` log occurs only after transaction commit. [LivePositionProtectionService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:53), [MarketPriceEventService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/market/service/MarketPriceEventService.java:80)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** On the live protection STOP_LOSS route, the wallet-managed position and its `wallet_trade` SELL are updated first; only if that mechanical wallet exit returns true does the service close the matching open `paper_position` and write an immutable `production_exit_audit` record. [LivePositionProtectionService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/position/service/LivePositionProtectionService.java:173), [WalletAutoExecutionService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/wallet/service/WalletAutoExecutionService.java:475)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** The signal-driven close route has a materially different order: `PaperTradingService.completeClose` persists `paper_position` first, then attempts the wallet exit and catches a wallet exception. Thus a selected closed paper row does not, by itself, prove a matching wallet execution; reconciliation against `wallet_trade` is mandatory. [PaperTradingService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/service/PaperTradingService.java:487)

- **[PROJECT EVIDENCE]** The durable linkage is not numerical identity between `paper_position.id` and `wallet_managed_position.id`. It is `paper_position.signal_id → wallet_managed_position.entry_signal_id`; `ProductionExitAuditService` uses that relationship when it records `wallet_position_id`. [ProductionExitAuditService.java](C:/workspace/crypto-ai-trader-mysql/src/main/java/com/crypto/audit/service/ProductionExitAuditService.java:37)

- **[AGENT INFERENCE]** The Iteration-3 ICPUSDT log candidate (`WalletManagedPosition` ID `182`, event `1837489`) is consistent with a committed live STOP_LOSS route, but remains unlinked to frozen `paper_position` ID `182`. It must not be treated as evidence for that frozen trade until the linkage query succeeds.

### DB_REQUEST

QueryId: DBQ-CODEX-I4-001  
Purpose: Prove each frozen paper position’s durable route, including entry/exit signals, managed-position linkage, recorded terminal trigger, wallet execution evidence, and accepted/non-canonical price events around close. All timestamps returned are UTC.  
SQL:

```sql
SELECT
    pp.id AS paper_position_id,
    pp.symbol,
    pp.status,
    pp.quantity,
    pp.entry_price,
    pp.stop_loss,
    pp.take_profit,
    pp.exit_price,
    pp.realized_pnl,
    pp.signal_id AS entry_signal_id,
    pp.exit_signal_id,
    pp.close_reason,
    pp.exit_reason,
    pp.opened_at,
    pp.closed_at,
    es.interval_code AS entry_interval,
    es.decision AS entry_decision,
    es.original_decision AS entry_original_decision,
    es.latest_price AS entry_signal_price,
    es.generated_at AS entry_signal_generated_at,
    xs.interval_code AS exit_interval,
    xs.decision AS exit_decision,
    xs.original_decision AS exit_original_decision,
    xs.latest_price AS exit_signal_price,
    xs.generated_at AS exit_signal_generated_at,
    wmp.id AS wallet_managed_position_id,
    wmp.status AS wallet_managed_position_status,
    wmp.average_entry_price_usdt,
    wmp.stop_loss_usdt,
    wmp.take_profit_usdt,
    pea.id AS production_exit_audit_id,
    pea.close_trigger AS audit_close_trigger,
    pea.source_signal_id AS audit_source_signal_id,
    pea.source_signal_decision AS audit_source_signal_decision,
    pea.wallet_position_id AS audit_wallet_position_id,
    pea.close_explanation AS audit_close_explanation,
    pea.audited_at
FROM paper_position pp
LEFT JOIN trade_signal es ON es.id = pp.signal_id
LEFT JOIN trade_signal xs ON xs.id = pp.exit_signal_id
LEFT JOIN wallet_managed_position wmp ON wmp.entry_signal_id = pp.signal_id
LEFT JOIN production_exit_audit pea ON pea.paper_position_id = pp.id
WHERE pp.id IN (182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137)
ORDER BY FIELD(pp.id, 182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137);

SELECT
    pp.id AS paper_position_id,
    wmp.id AS wallet_managed_position_id,
    wt.id AS wallet_trade_id,
    wt.signal_id,
    wt.execution_key,
    wt.symbol,
    wt.side,
    wt.quantity,
    wt.price_usdt,
    wt.decision_price_usdt,
    wt.execution_price_observed_at,
    wt.gross_amount_usdt,
    wt.fee_usdt,
    wt.net_amount_usdt,
    wt.cost_basis_usdt,
    wt.realized_pnl_usdt,
    wt.execution_reason,
    wt.status,
    wt.executed_at,
    wt.execution_message
FROM paper_position pp
LEFT JOIN wallet_managed_position wmp ON wmp.entry_signal_id = pp.signal_id
JOIN wallet_trade wt
  ON wt.signal_id IN (pp.signal_id, pp.exit_signal_id)
  OR (
      wmp.id IS NOT NULL
      AND wt.execution_key LIKE CONCAT('POSITION:', wmp.id, ':%')
  )
WHERE pp.id IN (182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137)
ORDER BY pp.id, wt.executed_at, wt.id;

SELECT
    pp.id AS paper_position_id,
    pp.symbol,
    pp.closed_at,
    mpe.id AS market_price_event_id,
    mpe.observed_at,
    mpe.price,
    mpe.source,
    mpe.delivery_status,
    mpe.ordering_slot,
    mpe.outcome_reason,
    mpe.created_at
FROM paper_position pp
JOIN market_price_event mpe
  ON mpe.symbol = pp.symbol
 AND mpe.observed_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(pp.closed_at, INTERVAL 15 SECOND)
                         AND DATE_ADD(pp.closed_at, INTERVAL 15 SECOND)
WHERE pp.id IN (182, 172, 162, 158, 143, 137)
ORDER BY pp.id, mpe.observed_at, mpe.id;
```
